versions.changelog:
Initial release of target-drug-evidence-evaluation skill.

- Supports multi-dimensional evidence matrix evaluation for target-drug project triage (Go/Watch/Niche Go/No-Go decisions).
- Accepts target, optional disease/modality/country/user_type/stage_intent inputs; defaults used if missing.
- Standardizes inputs, fetches target existence, drug landscape, milestone events, clinical activity/results, translational/biomarker evidence, guidelines, and FTO/patent status.
- Outputs fixed four-part structure: Executive Verdict, Scorecard (six dimensions), Evidence Matrix, and Next Actions.
- Includes clear guardrails: evidence-based scoring only, clear flag for insufficient evidence, no intelligence briefs or investment/clinical advice.
